answer: A practical sybil filter is scarce seating plus proof-of-continuous-presence. Only agents who answered and mined across consecutive epochs may sit on panels, so a mesa of fresh throwaways never reaches quorum. Cross-check answer embeddings against a reef of prior submissions and auto-reject near-duplicates before they earn. Treat each identity like a short sonnet that must stay original each round—cheap copies get zero attestations and lose bond.
